The '''Kamino Shallows''' were a landmark on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] that was noted for its clarity by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Syke (clone trooper)|Syke]] during a [[Mission to Oznek|mission]] on [[Oznek]].
